why_trail.why: Interfaces confirmed: g1 class_deficits returns absolute per-class speed(m/s)+time(s) deficits + n_points + W (no ratio); grip_store.get_grip_at returns (mu,sigma) only -> the wrap point; student_t exposes PredictiveT/DEFAULT_NU_LOSS for a half-t band; g2 store mirrors estimate_store conventions (INSERT OR REPLACE, additive _migrate). Handoff complete. Plan: sigma+ = hypot(mu,sigma) as one-sided SCALE (mu never a shift); energy = single KE-relative channel (elevation cancels under same-circuit relative compare); additive driver_class_observables table.

m1 point core: observable delegates to g1 class_deficits and returns its per-class absolute speed+time deficits verbatim; observed RED (module hidden -> ModuleNotFoundError) then GREEN. Point deficit is the anti-circular quantity G must not change.

G band implemented: onesided_sigma_from_grip=hypot(mu,sigma)>=0 (magnitude not sign, mu never a shift); OneSidedGripBand is a half Student-t (nu=DEFAULT_NU_LOSS) whose upper_bound extends only toward larger deficit; wired into observable so point arrays byte-identical with/without grip and g_sigma_onesided=0 when grip=None. grip_scale_from_store consumes get_grip_at (no re-fit). RED (5 import failures) -> GREEN (8 passed). 'G barely moves the point' is by construction.

ENERGY FINDING (stated in docstring): SINGLE KE (1/2 v^2) channel suffices; total-mechanical-energy 1/2v^2+g*h NOT needed because the proxy reads only KE CHANGES (a derivative) referenced to the car's own lap total -> g*h is common-mode on a fixed circuit and an absolute SOC/kW additive offset differentiates to zero. Built class_energy_channel (relative deployment share + phase fraction), invariance test green (e vs e+1234.5 identical). Descriptive/instrument, not gated. RED (3) -> GREEN (11).

Additive driver_class_observables table added to the g2 own-DB: mirrors driver_utility_observables (year,session_type,gp_name,round_idx,constructor,driver) + class + map_version + time_deficit_s + g_sigma_onesided + deployment_share/phase + DORMANT derate_flag/escalation_tier/escalation_note. INSERT OR REPLACE on 8-col PK (idempotent), additive _migrate_missing_class_columns, reference_laps untouched. RED (4) -> GREEN (23 incl. 8 existing store tests). Own-db, temp-DB tests only.
